razonamiento: Merged visual whiteboard boxes with narration details for the PixelStrings video processing platform. b0 represents the end-user web client. b1 represents the EC2 instance hosting the PixelStrings web server and job manager. b4 is the database used to cache job and media metadata (cataloged as ThirdParty). b5 represents the customer-managed S3 bucket storing media files. b6 is the AWS Lambda function running MediaInfo for asset inspection. b2 represents the GPU-enabled G3 EC2 cluster hosting the asset manager and video processing engine (Wormhole/Dark Energy/Spacetime). b3 represents the EC2 instance dedicated to Interoperable Master Format (IMF) processing. Lines were unified with spoken workflows into ingestion/metadata inspection (flow 0) and processing/packaging/delivery (flow 1).

nodes.name: User Web Browser
nodes.notes: Accesses service via standard web browser

nodes.name: PixelStrings Server
nodes.notes: Hosts web server and job manager

nodes.name: Customer S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores input and output media clips

edges.notes: User uploads input clips to S3 bucket
edges.respaldo: line b0->b5 / 'The user uploads their input clips to an S3 bucket that they manage.'

edges.notes: User accesses web server to initiate jobs
edges.respaldo: line b0->b1 / 'They create an account on the PixelStrings server, which is running here on EC2 instance.'

edges.notes: Web server returns UI response to browser
Job manager invokes Lambda to extract media metadata
edges.respaldo: line b1->b6 / 'the job manager uses Lambda to get metadata from the S3 bucket'

edges.notes: Lambda requests media headers from S3
edges.respaldo: line b6->b5 / 'uses Lambda to get metadata from the S3 bucket from each clip inside there.'

edges.notes: S3 returns file header info to Lambda
Lambda returns extracted metadata to job manager
Job manager saves metadata to database
edges.respaldo: line b1->b4 / 'it saves the metadata to the database.'

edges.notes: Web server reads cached job/clip metadata
edges.respaldo: line b4->b1 / 'It actually talks to the database.'

edges.notes: Job manager commands asset manager on G3 cluster to process clip
edges.respaldo: line b1->b2 / 'job manager tells the asset manager to copy the input clip to the local disk of the G3.'

edges.notes: Asset manager copies clip from S3 to G3 local disk
edges.respaldo: line b5->b2 / 'asset manager to copy the input clip to the local disk of the G3.'

edges.notes: G3 cluster reports job status back to job manager
Asset manager copies processed output clip back to customer S3 bucket
edges.respaldo: line b2->b5 / 'Then job manager tells the asset manager, copy the output clip back to the customer's bucket.'

edges.notes: Dispatches media data to IMF processing instance
edges.respaldo: line b2->b3 / 'Instead, it sends the data to IMF.'

edges.notes: IMF instance retrieves media assets from S3
IMF instance stores packaged masters in S3

edges.respaldo: line b5->b0 / 'And then the asset manager copies the result. Oh, copies back to the user.'
